name: living-practice
label: See · Liberate · Create · Cultivate
description: Brought across from a page made elsewhere; every word, picture and link is a field.

defaults.heading: See · Liberate · Create · Cultivate
defaults.text: We align. We wander. We listen. We return.

cards.heading: See
cards.text: Meet what is actually here. Witness yourself, your patterns, your beauty, your stories, your desires, your edges and the life moving around you.

cards.heading: Liberate
cards.text: Meet what constricts your aliveness. Uncover conditioning. Feel what has been waiting to be felt. Reclaim forgotten parts.

cards.heading: Create
cards.text: Give form to what you discover. Your voice. Your movement. Your work. Your imagery. Your relationships. Your next chapter.

cards.heading: Cultivate
cards.text: Tend what you wish to become. Through repetition, relationship, ritual, nourishment and care, create the conditions in which a truer life can grow.

defaults.text2: These are not steps. They are movements in a living spiral.
